# Alert

Inline message that tells the user about a state: info, success, warning, error or neutral.

`KenosUI.Alert` · Feedback

## Use

```jsx
<KenosUI.Alert>…</KenosUI.Alert>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="KenosUI.Alert">…</x-import>
```

## Props (AlertProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `"info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" \| "neutral"` | Default "info". "error" uses the red accent. |
| `variant` | `"subtle" \| "surface" \| "outline" \| "solid"` | Default "subtle". |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Default "md". |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `icon` | `React.ReactNode \| false` | Replace the status icon, or `false` to hide it. |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, "title">._
